sourceTitle: Do I own the assets (websites/images/videos/slides) generated via Manus?
basis: Official Manus Help Center says users own generated content and may use it personally or commercially, subject to applicable law and third-party rights.
application: Supports commercial-use/ownership evidence for authenticated built-in Manus outputs documented by the recovered session tool receipts. It is not a CC0 dedication, third-party-input license, noninfringement warranty, or confirmation that the current distributor is the creating user or has assignment.
